name: VW Golf R (Mk7, 2015)
chassisNote: Same Haldex AWD hot-hatch slot as the Focus RS Mk3 already in the game; rally archetype + fit.drive awd.

gearset.src: VW US 2015 Golf R technical specifications PDF: MQ350 6MT 3.36/2.09/1.48/1.09/1.10/0.91, Final I 4.24 (1–4), Final II 3.27 (5–6). Gears 5–6 scaled by 3.27/4.24 so a single fd matches GR Yaris / RS3 dual-final pattern.

enginePreset.name: VW EA888 2.0 TSI (Golf R Mk7)
enginePreset.note: EU/UK Mk7 Golf R EA888 Gen3: 300 PS from 5500–6200, 380 Nm from 1800–5500 (VW UK press pack). Separate from the existing GTI EA888 preset (220 hp / 350 Nm). US cars were SAE 292 hp; this pack pins the EU rating. Peak boost ~1.2 bar typical for the R calibration (unsure).

sources.engine: https://www.vwpress.co.uk/assets/documents/original/17499-Golf_R_Press_Pack_0716.pdf — 300 PS 5500–6200, 380 Nm 1800–5500, 0–62 mph 5.1 s manual / 4.9 s DSG, top 155 mph limited.
sources.body: VW UK press pack kerbweight 1476 kg (3-door manual); VW US 2015 tech specs PDF — Cd 0.32, wb 2630 mm, 1799×1436 mm, tracks 1541/1515, front rotors 13.4 in (340 mm), 225/40 R18.
sources.performance: VW UK press pack: 0–62 mph 5.1 s (manual), top speed electronically limited to 155 mph (250 km/h).
sources.gearset: https://media.vw.com/assets/documents/original/6387-1646354283566f0c7d73925.pdf — 2015 Golf R Technical Specifications, manual column.
sources.fit: VW US 2015 tech specs: 4Motion Haldex AWD, strut front / multilink rear, 225/40 R18, 13.4-in vented front discs.

note: Pinned EU/UK Mk7 (pre-7.5) 3-door 6MT, 300 PS. body.kg is the VW UK kerbweight 1476 kg; if a later DIN sheet proves that figure includes the 75 kg driver, subtract 75 (listed unsure). Frontal area = 1.799 × 1.436 × 0.81 ≈ 2.09 m² (estimate). fWt 0.59 from a Motor Trend instrumented Euro-spec car (~59/41). Factory aero sits inside Cd 0.32 — aF/aR/aFl none. Dual final drive modelled like GR Yaris (scale 5–6). Separate engine from Golf GTI EA888.
